title: Happyend (bc30)
synopsis: In near-future Tokyo, a prank on the school principal leads to the installation of an oppressive surveillance system. While the incident awakens high schooler Kou's political consciousness, his best friend Yuta remains oblivious, creating a rift that threatens their bond. Following Ryuichi Sakamoto: Opus, Neo Sora delivers a poignant feature debut exploring whether adolescent bonds can survive a volatile political landscape. While met with a modest reception in its native Japan, the film resonated deeply in Hong Kong, its first overseas theatrical stop, paving the way for the widespread international attention that followed.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 在未來的東京，大地震的威脅逼在眉睫，在高度戒備下，政府施以日益嚴密的社會控制。高中生裕太和寇頸上永遠掛着耳機，形影不離的他們同樣熱愛電子音樂，卻於一次地下音樂會被警察逮捕。成人堅稱監控系統可以保障學生安全，但少年卻感覺被當成囚犯。青春固然躁動不安，在政治意識啟蒙下，二人的友誼經得起前所未有的分歧嗎？空音央首部長片探討右翼與民族主義所帶來的潛在危機，以末世寓言細看當今日本的社會矛盾。電影在日本本土反應平平，在首個海外上映地香港卻引起巨大共鳴，為其後在多地廣受好評打響頭炮。

cast: Hayato Kurihara, Yukito Hidaka, Yuta Hayashi, Ayumu Nakajima, Makiko Watanabe
